chapter: Family, Margaret's story and Eutris's memories
title: Charleston, West Virginia: Little Old New York
summary: Detroit musicians and a wake serving whiskey lead into Charleston as a town of gangsters and musicians.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition

blocks.x: No, the reason why I asked you that was because I'm also from Detroit.
I was born in 1932. Now if Eli was born about 1940 I might know him.
He just died a couple of weeks ago. He was a trombone player too... There was one, my friend, he was getting to be very, very famous. He got killed in a car wreck up here.

George (Thomas?) His name was Thompson. That was the first time I ever went to a wake where they served whiskey. I went home and told my mother, "You know George -" - he got killed at the height of his career -

No..... We were all young then. I went to the wake, you know, and his mother said that's the way he would want it. I said I never heard of anybody serving whiskey at a wake before. That was my first time. You see, Charleston, West Virginia, was a town - they used to call it "Little Old New York" where we had the best gangsters and the best musicians. to come through there. Q: Can you tell us something about him when you first met?
